about.lead: I like making complex things simple, and simple things last.
about.p1: Hi, I'm Zhang Yiming — Evan is my English name. I study Electrical Engineering and Automation, and keep a few small hobbies on the side.
about.p2: Outside of study I play games, take photos and wander around the internet. If you're working on something interesting, or just want to talk ideas, feel free to reach out.
